notes.title: That's My Space - Update 0.8.4
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello space travelers! I bring news and changes that will make your gameplays much more varied![/h3]

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*] 4 New Ores
[*] 2 New debris
[*] 3 New defense equipment
[*] Planets can now be dominated
[*] Enemy progression system
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked and balanced all item recipes.
[*] Starship AI fix.
[*] Performance fix when exiting the match.
[*] Fixed the Scavenger ship's hit box.
[/list]

[h2]Mining System[/h2]
Now that we have new ores and debris scattered across the galaxy, we can slightly change the way we progress through the game. The ores came so that you can make wise decisions when it comes to progressing your equipment, taking into account your priorities in each situation in the game. The debris, however, provide you with a large amount of resources and even new weapons to repair, if you are lucky enough to find one on your journey.

[h2]Enemy Progression[/h2]
Enemies will now become more robust with each weapon upgrade made by the player. Existing enemies will maintain their current level, but new enemies will appear stronger and more resistant. In order for you to be able to do better against them, 3 defensive equipment were added, to increase Defense and Health. Trust me, every point in defense makes a lot of difference in the final damage taken.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
[b]Listed by priority[/b]
[list]
[*] New Enemies
[*] New weapons
[*] Additional mechanics on planet domination
[/list]

[b]New Enemies and Weapons[/b]
I believe the time has come to increase the bestiary and arsenal. I'll be focusing on adding enemies with greater attack diversity to make your life a lot harder when trying to invade a planet. But don't worry traveler, I'll also be bringing you good news and increasing your arsenal so you can get rid of all enemies in the most innovative ways possible.

[b]Planet Domination[/b]
Now, when you destroy a moon, the planet turns into a planet of the Valley Nation. At the moment, this just means that enemies will no longer spawn on that planet. I'm still planning exactly what mechanic will be added when a planet is taken over, so if you want to leave any suggestions, join our official Discord server and post your idea!

[url=https://discord.gg/SMBZNfCDDk][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44117241/ac3b16fbe1dba5bfeb4bcbad1e1840ad2b16af15.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: That's My Space - Update 0.8.3
notes.notes:
[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*] 6 new unlockable spaceships.
[*] 6 new spaceship mastery Achievements.
[/list]
[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Booster Turbine upgrades now lower the energy consumption.
[*] Changes on the knockback calculation.
[*] Galapagos Spaceship now has increased knockback.
[/list]
[h1]What's coming next?[/h1]
[b]Listed by priority[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy Progression System
[*] Defense Upgrades
[/list]
[b]Progression System[/b]
When you get some of the upgraded weapons in Adventure Mode, you start being absolutely unstoppable. But don't you think it's too early for the universe to be yours? Well, probably. That's why I'm already planning some enemy progression. The idea is to have new attack patterns that will unlock when you get higher level gear, instead of only extremelly scaling all enemy stats (they will be scaled too though, but not too much). This may take a lot of time and research, and will probably be added in baby steps.

[b]Defense Upgrades[/b]
Today we have many offensive options for space domination, but what about spacial safety? With that in mind, I came up with some deffensive equipment ideas that will fit this need in more deffensive playstyles. 

[h2]Content Spoilers[/h2]
Crusader: [spoiler]Equip Repair Bot+5[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Starts with Repair Bot+1, has increased Damage, Max Health and Health Regen[/spoiler]
Destroyer: [spoiler]Equip Laser Shotgun+5[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Starts with Laser Shotgun, has increased Fire Rate, Knockback and Damage[/spoiler]
Diamond: [spoiler]Equip Diagonal Lasers+5[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Starts with Diagonal Lasers, has increased Fire Rate and Crit. Chance[/spoiler]
Marauder: [spoiler]Equip Rocket Launcher+5[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Starts with Rocket Launcher, has increased Fire Rate, Knockback and Damage[/spoiler]
Rogue: [spoiler]Equip the Booster Turbine+5[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Starts with Booster Turbine+1, has increased Fire Rate and Crit. Chance[/spoiler]
Scavenger: [spoiler]Equip the Gravitation Field+5[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Starts with Gravitation Field+1, has increased Damage, Max Health and Health Regen[/spoiler]

notes.notes:

[*] Depending on the distance to the player, Kryon sometimes would not spawn.
[*] Fixed a bug where Boost Turbines were stacking their speeds when changing upgrades.
[*] Increased the drop rate of Starships.
[*] Removed "Small Lasers", "Big Lasers" and "Diagonal Lasers" from the Starship drops.
[/list]

Know bug:
[list]
[*] Some players might experience a black screen in the Survival Mode game over screen. I'm already analysing this issue.
[/list]
In case these unsolved bugs, or any unlisted bug happens to you, please send the log file located at "\Users\{User}\AppData\LocalLow\Dois4Sete\ThatsMySpace" in our official [url=https://discord.gg/vbThgtumMt]Discord Server[/url].
